crossRefs.note: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked…
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he…
In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

translations.web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
translations.bsb: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
translations.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
translations.asv: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
